headword: {中枢神経|ちゅうすうしんけい}

definitions.explanation: The part of the nervous system consisting of the brain and spinal cord, which integrates sensory information and coordinates the activity of the body.

examples.japanese: {中枢神経|ちゅうすうしんけい}の{働|はたら}き。
examples.english: The function of the central nervous system.

examples.japanese: この{薬|くすり}は{中枢神経|ちゅうすうしんけい}に{作用|さよう}する。
examples.english: This medicine acts on the central nervous system.

examples.japanese: {脳|のう}と{脊髄|せきずい}を{合|あ}わせて{中枢神経|ちゅうすうしんけい}{系|けい}と{呼|よ}ぶ。
examples.english: The brain and spinal cord together are called the central nervous system.

notes:
A medical and biological term referring to the brain ({脳|のう}) and spinal cord ({脊髄|せきずい}) taken together. {中枢|ちゅうすう} means "center" or "core," and {神経|しんけい} means "nerve," so the literal meaning is "central nerve(s)." The term is commonly used in discussions of medicine, pharmacology, and physiology.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {中枢神経|ちゅうすうしんけい}{系|けい}: the central nervous system (as a system)
- {中枢神経|ちゅうすうしんけい}に{作用|さよう}する: to act on the central nervous system
- {中枢神経|ちゅうすうしんけい}を{抑制|よくせい}する: to suppress the central nervous system
- {中枢神経|ちゅうすうしんけい}の{障害|しょうがい}: damage to the central nervous system

RELATED WORDS:
- {末梢神経|まっしょうしんけい}: peripheral nervous system — the nerves outside the brain and spinal cord
- {自律神経|じりつしんけい}: autonomic nervous system — controls involuntary functions
- {神経系|しんけいけい}: nervous system (as a whole)
- {脳|のう}: brain
- {脊髄|せきずい}: spinal cord
